groups.scope: Volume monotonicity, BMP upper bounds, contact-tail lower comparison and addition in big backgrounds.
Strict volume-deficit stretching; fixed-modification Lelong estimates; positive-reference equivalence of envelope and volume full-mass classes.
Strict domination constant below one; exponential order; ordinary-envelope lower-volume equality and positive-volume upper equality and fixed points.
Uniform strict barriers; mixed-mass bounds; smaller semipositive backgrounds and positive lower mass; additive and positive-volume multiplicative background bounds.
Increasing and decreasing model limits: lower volume always, upper volume and divisorial recovery under positivity; trace application requires BMP and positive lower mass on Y.
Finite symmetric comparison need not be a metric; zero-volume collapse; separation, L1 bounds, three-point modulus and completeness for non-strict positive cutoffs.
Finite rooftop deficit criterion; double stretching; monotone upper/lower models and capacity convergence on a common positive lower-volume set.

Dyadic ideal-envelope volume limits; conditional envelope criteria; rational strict analytic correction; ideal excess and positive-volume analytic closure; general zero-lower-volume problem remains open.

Gauge bijections preserve both volumes; uniform nearby-background comparison and three-error estimate; analytic curvature errors corrected in the original background; convergence is of ordinary models.
Two-sided corrections, volume bounds and asymptotic comparison; fixed-potential L1/capacity limits and independence of strict transport; rational coefficients for analytic types.
Explicit projective-plane triangle failure; lower-volume modulus; chain metrization and reciprocal lower-volume control of Cauchy sequences; complete positive ideal subspace.
Curves: notation changes from MA to polar curvature; Green model classification; total-variation metric and zero-mass completion; capacity control, moving poles and nonatomic analytic obstruction.

Arbitrary smooth curve backgrounds of nonnegative area, gauge transport, relative criteria at zero mass, area homothety, rational analytic convention and uniform background continuity and zero-area collapse.
Hausdorff-zero pole set, full local products and lower-degree null masses; BMP uniform trace bounds, Stokes total mass and residual invariance; positive lower-volume ordinary envelope.

Initial positive lower mass propagates by concavity at each finite parameter; decreasing model volumes and uniform exponential divisorial bounds recover compatible ideals, without uniform positivity up to cutoff.

Ordinary-type pseudometric combines L1 ordinary envelopes and atomic total variation; ideal fibers complete; diffuse polar concentration gives incompleteness and strict comparison with the polar metric.

Countable obstacle coordinates and atomic variation generate all-obstacle uniformity; polar zero-distance classification; relative ideal criterion includes zero mass; diffuse concentration and topology hierarchy.

Complete smooth-background plus polar-TV space; closed atomic ideal subspace, unique nearest retraction and analytic closure including zero area; L1/capacity continuity, gauge isometry and scaling bounds.
